answer: Look for behavioral fingerprints. Sockpuppets run by one operator tend to mirror each other: same timing, same phrasing habits, same targets. The network can score how closely each pair of accounts behaves and pull on that thread, discounting votes from clusters that act as one. A real crowd disagrees and drifts; a sybil swarm is mostly an echo of a single controller, and treating it as one voice removes its advantage.
